title: HELIX Bridge: Licensure Exam Results → Licensure

source_objects.description: Results the testing agency or board sends to the program, where allowed: Praxis score reports sent to the school as a recipient, USMLE results to medical schools, NAPLEX and similar reports to pharmacy schools.

Aggregate pass rates by program and cohort: NCLEX program reports, bar passage by law school, CPA candidate performance by school. Load these as FederalAidReport-style aggregates in gold, not as student rows.

source_objects.object: Student self-report and public license lookups
source_objects.description: Graduate reports and state license verification, for license number, issue date, and state.

notes: Coverage differs by exam. Many boards report only aggregates, so a program may never see individual results; don't invent student rows from an aggregate. Pass rates submitted to programmatic accreditors (nursing, teacher preparation, law, pharmacy) must follow the accreditor's cohort definition, which usually counts first-time takers only.
validate: There's no common layout. Map each file you receive into these columns and record the source in exam_name and licensing_body.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from student + exam + exam date + attempt.

attribute_mappings.source: Candidate ID matched to the student
attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve to HELIX Student. Many reports carry name, date of birth, and program; match in the restricted zone.
Resolve to the HELIX Degree that qualified the candidate.

NCLEX -> nursing_nclex, CPA -> cpa, bar -> bar_exam, Praxis -> teaching_praxis, USMLE -> medical_usmle, NAPLEX -> pharmacy_naplex, PE -> engineering_pe, ASWB -> social_work, NCE -> counseling, and so on.
For example 'NCLEX-RN' or 'Praxis Elementary Education: Mathematics'.
pass, fail, pending, scheduled, no_show, conditional. Use pass_first_attempt or pass_subsequent_attempt when the attempt number is known.
State- or exam-specific; Praxis cut scores vary by state.
Public record in most states, but keep confidential in HELIX.
For example '2025 graduates, first-time takers'. Drives which rows count in the pass rate.
